automation.ai_triage_hint: Sets labels, priority, sentiment and language from the conversation.
automation.ai_decide_placeholder: Is the customer at risk of churning?
automation.ai_decide_hint: Ollie answers with a probability of yes. Every question in one run is asked together.

settings.title: AI
settings.description: Drafts, summaries, translation and triage for your team. Customer content goes only to the configured provider and is never used for training.
settings.read_only: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.enabled_hint: Turns every AI feature on or off for everyone. Nothing is sent to the provider while it's off.
settings.assistant_section_hint: {{name}} is the assistant in the header. It works with each teammate's own permissions.
settings.assistant_hint: Answers questions about the queue, finds tickets and prepares changes. Nothing changes until the teammate approves it, except the changes you let it make without asking below. Each message is charged to the AI balance.
settings.assistant_peer_hint: Members choose for themselves whether their {{name}} answers, who may ask, and what it shares from their mail. Off by default.
settings.auto_run_hint: Off by default. {{name}} makes the changes you switch on here as soon as it decides to, with the teammate's own permissions, and marks each one as made without asking.
settings.auto_run_always: Replies, messages to people outside the team and changes to other settings always ask first, whatever you choose here.

auto_run_tools_hint.update_ticket: Assignee, status, priority, labels and fields of one ticket.
auto_run_tools_hint.bulk_update_tickets: The same change on up to 50 tickets at once.
auto_run_tools_hint.add_note: Notes are seen by the team only.
auto_run_tools_hint.create_kb_draft: Drafts stay unpublished until someone publishes them.
auto_run_tools_hint.create_view: Saved for the teammate who asked.
auto_run_tools_hint.create_automation_draft: Admins only. It stays off until someone turns it on.

settings.automatic_hint: These run without anyone asking, and are charged to the AI balance each time.
settings.auto_triage_hint: Suggests labels, priority, sentiment and language on every new ticket, before your automations run.
settings.auto_summarize_hint: Refreshes the summary on tickets with five or more messages.
settings.widget_answers_hint: Ollie replies to chat visitors from your help center, knowledge and tools, labels replies as AI and hands off to your team when it should.
settings.tone_hint: Applied to drafted replies. Agents can still ask for a different tone each time.
settings.custom_tone_placeholder: Warm and direct, like a helpful colleague
settings.reply_language_hint: Drafts can follow the customer's language or always use your workspace's.
settings.instructions_hint: Extra guidance for every draft: product names, policies, things to avoid.
settings.instructions_placeholder: Call the product Margin, never Margin App. Offer a refund only for charges in the last 30 days.
settings.embeddings_on: Semantic search finds related tickets and articles by meaning.
settings.embeddings_off: No embeddings provider, so search matches keywords.
settings.costs_hint: Charged to the AI balance only when a call succeeds.
settings.not_configured: AI isn't set up on this instance
settings.not_configured_hint: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or point OPENAI_BASE_URL at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including a local model), then restart opendesk.
settings.main_model_hint: Writes drafts, answers and summaries. Default follows this instance's setting. A pricier model costs more per call.
settings.fast_model_hint: Handles triage, rewrites and other short tasks.
settings.costs_metered_hint: What a typical call costs on the models you chose. Each call costs what it uses, so longer conversations and pricier models cost more. Charged only when a call succeeds.
settings.own_key_costs: AI calls run on your own key and cost nothing on opendesk. Decision model calls (triage, the chat relevance check, automation decisions) still cost a little from the AI balance.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Pay for AI from the workspace's AI balance, or use your own provider key. Calls on your key cost nothing on opendesk.
provider.description_self_hosted: Use this instance's provider, or your own key for this workspace.
provider.instance_hint: Every AI call uses {{provider}} through opendesk and is charged to the AI balance, in US dollars, on what it uses.
provider.instance_hint_self_hosted: Every AI call uses the provider this instance is set up with ({{provider}}).
provider.kind_openrouter_hint: One key for Claude, GPT, Gemini and hundreds more. Requests only go to providers that don't keep or train on prompts.
provider.kind_openai_hint: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or any server with an OpenAI-compatible API.
provider.base_url_hint: The API root, ending before /chat/completions. HTTPS on a public address.
provider.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted. Only the last 4 characters are ever shown again.
provider.model_hint: The model this endpoint should use by default.
provider.fast_model_hint: Optional. Used for triage, rewrites and other short tasks.
provider.saved: Your key is saved. AI now runs on it.
provider.remove_body: AI goes back to the opendesk AI balance right away. Your key is deleted from opendesk.
provider.remove_body_self_hosted: AI goes back to this instance's provider right away. Your key is deleted from opendesk.
provider.fix_rejected: AI features are paused until the key works again. Replace it with an active key.
provider.fix_no_funds: AI features are paused until the account has funds. Add funds at {{provider}}, or replace the key.
provider.stays: Embeddings for search stay on opendesk at no charge.
provider.stays_self_hosted: Embeddings for search stay on this instance's provider.
provider.decisions_typesafe_key: Triage, automation questions and mail categories run on Jev with your TypeSafe key. They cost nothing on opendesk.
provider.decisions_provider_jev: Triage, automation questions and mail categories run on Jev through your OpenRouter key. They cost nothing on opendesk.
provider.decisions_provider_llm: Triage, automation questions and mail categories run on your own key with the AI model.
provider.decisions_instance: Triage, automation questions and mail categories run on opendesk and cost a little from the AI balance. Add a TypeSafe key to run them on your own account.
provider.decisions_instance_self_hosted: Triage, automation questions and mail categories run on this instance's decision model. Add a TypeSafe key to run them on your own account.
provider.decisions_none: No decision model is set up. Add a TypeSafe key for decisions with calibrated confidence.
provider.decisions_key_hint: Used for decisions only, whichever provider runs the rest. Stored encrypted. Only the last 4 characters are ever shown again.
provider.decisions_saved: Your TypeSafe key is saved. Decisions now run on it.
provider.decisions_remove_body: Decisions stop using this key right away, and the key is deleted from opendesk.
provider.decisions_fix_rejected: Decisions are paused until the key works again. Replace it with an active key.
provider.decisions_fix_no_funds: Decisions are paused until the account has funds. Add funds at TypeSafe, or replace the key.

kb_draft.title: Draft an article from tickets
kb_draft.description: Pick the conversations that answer the question, or describe the topic. The draft fills the editor; nothing is published until you do.
kb_draft.topic_placeholder: Resetting SSO when the identity provider rotates its certificate
kb_draft.need_input: Choose a ticket or describe a topic.
kb_draft.replace_body: The draft replaces the current title, excerpt and body. You can still discard before saving.
kb_draft.done: Draft ready. Review it before publishing.
kb_draft.step_find: Finding what the answers have in common

palette.ask_hint: Search by meaning across tickets and articles
palette.placeholder: Ask anything, like customers who were charged twice
palette.empty: Nothing related yet. Try describing the problem in other words.
palette.start: Describe what you're looking for in plain words.
palette.error: Couldn't search right now. Try again in a moment.
palette.example_2: Sign-in problems after a password reset
